items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Well, John Hammond had money... He was supporting and pushing Benny Goodman and along with Count Basie.

ctx.x: When you say with the help of John Hammond, what do you mean?

Well, John Hammond had money. Now, I don't know whether John Hammond was connected with the Hammond organ people. (not) Apparently he was, his parents, his people. Now, he had the money. He was supporting and pushing Benny Goodman and along with Count Basie. Now, Goodman married John's sister, John Hammond's sister, and where the money is, can't go wrong.

And Basie, naturally (he) started pushing Count Basie, which had -- he couldn't have picked a better swinging band lot of things in the world to me. Of course, (inaudible) in Basie's band were things that I particularly -- particularly didn't, you know, understand at that particular time. Of course, he came up under the influence of Benny Moten and people like that out of Kansas City.
